breakdown.description: The prompt sets the torsional shear stress to zero at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated that the torsional shear stress vanishes at the outer surface. The generated specification correctly removes this erroneous statement and instead uses the torsional shear stress τ from part (b) as τxy in the plane stress analysis, which matches the ground truth. The outer surface is correctly identified as the location of maximum torsional shear stress, and it is properly included in the principal stress calculation.
